title: UserProfile
description: A user profile stored in Firebase.

googleUserId.description: The unique ID of the user (from Google).

discordId.description: The unique ID of the user (from Discord).

discordServer.description: The unique ID of the Discord server the user belongs to.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the profile was created.

role.description: The user's role (managed by server only). Set by Admin SDK only, not directly editable by users.
